metadata.title: Yamanaka et al. (2023), Miao et al. (2023) & Adhyapok et al. (2021) Epithelial Somite Rosette Vertex Mechanics, Mesenchymal-to-Epithelial Transition (MET) & Somitecoel Lumen Formation Dataset

sources.citation: Yamanaka Y, Hamidi S, Yoshioka-Kobayashi K, et al., Alev C (2023). Reconstituting human somitogenesis in vitro. Nature 614(7948):509-520.

somitoid_rosette_specimen.species: Vertebrate dorsal embryo scanning electron micrograph showing bilateral epithelialized somite rosettes flanking the neural tube

somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.section: Adhyapok et al. (2021) Dev. Cell 56:1312-1324; Yamanaka et al. (2023) Nature 614:509-520; Miao et al. (2023) Nature 614:500-508
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.vertex_interfacial_energy_functional: E = sum_{i=1}^N [ (K_A / 2) * (A_i - A_0)^2 + gamma_ap * L_{ap,i} + gamma_lat * L_{lat,i} + gamma_bas * L_{bas,i} ]
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.radial_wedge_rosette_energy: E(R_in, N) = 2 * pi * gamma_ap * R_in + 2 * pi * gamma_bas * R_out + N * gamma_lat * (R_out - R_in),  with R_out = sqrt(R_in^2 + N * A_0 / pi)
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.wedge_angle_law: theta_wedge = 2 * pi / N,  L_ap = (2 * pi / N) * R_in < L_bas = (2 * pi / N) * R_out
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.apical_basal_curvature_balance: dE/dR_in = 2 * pi * gamma_ap - N * gamma_lat + (2 * pi * gamma_bas + N * gamma_lat) * (R_in / R_out) = 0
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.analytical_equilibrium_lumen_radius: R_in / R_out = (N * gamma_lat - 2 * pi * gamma_ap) / (N * gamma_lat + 2 * pi * gamma_bas)  for 2 * pi * gamma_ap < N * gamma_lat
somite_rosette_vertex_governing_equation.eph_ephrin_cleft_sorting_energy: Delta_E_cleft = 2 * L_cleft * (gamma_het - (gamma_ant + gamma_post) / 2) > 0  when gamma_het > (gamma_ant + gamma_post) / 2

state_variables.R_in: Central somitecoel lumen radius (um), bounded by F-actin/ZO-1/pMLC2-enriched apical domain
state_variables.R_out: Outer somite rosette basal radius (um), bounded by Fibronectin/Laminin/Matrigel basal lamina
state_variables.gamma_ap: Apical actomyosin cortical line tension (pN/um), elevated by RhoA/ROCK/pMLC2 during MET
state_variables.gamma_bas: Basal cell-ECM interfacial tension (pN/um), lowered by Matrigel/fibronectin integrin engagement
state_variables.gamma_lat: Lateral N-cadherin (CDH2) homophilic cell-cell interfacial tension (pN/um)
state_variables.gamma_het: Heterotypic EphA4/ephrinB2 inter-somitic boundary line tension driving somite cleft separation

somitoid_experimental_regimes.label: WT Axioloid/Somitoid (+10% Matrigel, active ROCK/pMLC2 + EphA4/ephrinB2)
Low Matrigel (2.5% ECM, partially elevated gamma_bas = 0.95)
EphA4 / ephrinB2 boundary knockdown (gamma_het = 1.05, impaired clefting)
Y-27632 ROCK / Blebbistatin Myosin II inhibition (gamma_ap -> gamma_bas = 0.45)
Minus-Matrigel suspension control (0% ECM, unpolarized gamma_ap = gamma_bas = 0.72)
